metadata.description: Classic desktop games as Claude Code mods, played in a pane while Claude works.

plugins.name: minefield
plugins.description: The classic mine-clearing puzzle in a pane: click or use the keys to clear the board. A timer, a best time, and a face that watches the board and glances over at Claude's work.

plugins.name: doom
plugins.description: Doom in a pane: Freedoom on the doomgeneric engine, a real picture in kitty and Ghostty, block characters elsewhere. Walk with the keys, turn with the mouse or the keys, while Claude works.
